C0178.title: Inner Mongolia Su et al. Producing and Selling Counterfeit Sunflower Seeds Case
C0178.summary: In February 2024, Ulanqab police cracked a case involving the production and sale of counterfeit sunflower seeds. Su, the sales director of an Inner Mongolia seed company, sold expired sunflower seeds from 2013 at a low price of 50 yuan per bag to clear inventory.
